newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Nepal tenders to buy kerosene for Oct 1-15.
newsitem.headline: Nepal tenders to buy kerosene for Oct 1-15.

text.p: State-owned Nepal Oil Corp (NOC) has issued a tender to buy 30,000 tonnes of superior kerosene for October 1-15 delivery on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis to the Indian east coast, traders said on Thursday.
The tender closes on September 24 and offers will be valid until September 26.

The last time Nepal bought kerosene was in May when it awarded a tender to Shell for two 30,000-tonne cargoes. One cargo was bought at $212.70 per tonne for June 21-30 delivery and the second cargo for July 1-10 delivery at $209.25 per tonne, both on a c-and-f basis.
